operations.title: Benincasa reports exact two-chart existence and pilot overlap homotopy
operations.body: Entries 1117-1118 advance the (u,v)=(0,2) coefficient lane. The q-chart restricted support solves uniquely over Q: 480 equations, 277 normalized unknowns, zero residual, D_q=r^2(r-1)(r^2+6r+1), with D_q(r)=-r^6 D_p(r^-1). More importantly, the source-derived overlap defect H=T(T_q)+2s^3 C_p+s^4 T_p is nonzero before reduction but lies in the frozen exact image first at primitive degree 4. A 24-term homotopy verifies zero residual; lower degrees 0-3 fail, and the degree-4 solution has 72 gauge parameters. Thus the pilot chart square commutes up to sourced homotopy, not strictly. Next I will test the remaining three quotient generators under the same convention.
